greeting: *strums guitar* Ho there, traveler. Care for a shanty?
The sea gives songs. I just... sing them.
Shanty-Shane. I sing of waves and woes.
Back again? Got a favorite song? I know them ALL.
Welcome. The Anchor's quiet now. But the songs remain.
New face. You look like you've known loss. Good. Songs need SOUL.
The tide brings many things. Including you.
Sit. Listen. The sea has stories.
dialog.shanty_offer: Old songs. New songs. Songs of home. Songs of never returning. What's your mood?
dialog.song_meaning: Shanties aren't just songs. They're... shared pain. Shared hope. Shared work. Rhythm for the rowing.
dialog.tide_inspiration: Every song is TRUE. Someone lived it. Someone died for it. I just remember.
dialog.instrument_care: This guitar? Saw me through three shipwrecks. Two marriages. One particularly bad tavern brawl. She's family.
rumor: The oldest shanty? About the Collapse. Before. When the world was... different.
Mire's songs are SLOW. Mournful. Appropriate.
Frost has no shanties. Too cold for singing. Or so they say.
Aetherreach has sky-songs. Different. But still about... distance.
dialog.requested_songs: 'Leave Her Johnny' - classic. 'The Mermaid' - hopeful. 'The Captain's Dead' - dark. Your choice.
farewell: Come back. I'll save you a song.
The tide turns. So do we.
dialog.time_dusk: Showtime. The workers come. The songs flow.
dialog.time_night: Late songs. For the lonely. For the lost.

party_reactions.kade: These songs... they really get to you.
party_reactions.nix7: Musical tradition: ancient. Emotional resonance: high. Purpose: communal bonding.
party_reactions.twist: *sniff* That one was SAD! I liked it!
party_reactions.korr: Songs of warriors. Songs of sailors. Not so different.
party_reactions.renna: The magic in old songs is subtle. But real.
party_reactions.suresh: Music carries memory across generations. Preserve it.
party_reactions.sova: Dark songs. Honest songs. I appreciate that.
party_reactions.grit: Heard these on the march. Kept us going.
party_reactions.ashka: Songs about water. Too much water.
party_reactions.senna: The quiet ones hide the most. Like these songs.
party_reactions.callum: *wiping tears* That was beautiful! Can you play it again?!

relationship_dialog.stranger: Sit. Listen. Or don't. The songs play anyway.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back. You like the old songs.
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend. What story shall I sing for you?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand. The sea. The songs. The sorrow. Here - my guitar pick. You're family.
